title: GraphNIAH: A Benchmark for Long-Context Reasoning over Real-World Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.41704v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The needle-in-a-haystack (NIAH) benchmark was introduced as a test for measuring a model's ability to find small relevant facts within a very large body of input text. However, existing NIAH benchmarks each suffer from one or more of the following limitations: (1) reliance on synthetic data, so their evaluations may not generalize to real-world settings; (2) reuse of previously published datasets, leading to the risk of benchmark contamination; (3) dependence on manual annotation, which requires human effort to create and update data and is prone to future benchmark contamination; and (4) unrealistic simplification of long-context multi-hop reasoning where each next step is trivial given previous steps, while real-world reasoning often requires planning over multiple possible proof paths. To address these limitations, we introduce \Benchmark, a dynamic benchmark built from real citation relationships among scientific papers published aft

translated_title: GraphNIAH：一个面向真实世界图的长上下文推理基准测试
translated_abstract: 大海捞针测试被引入作为衡量模型在超大输入文本中查找小型相关事实能力的测试。然而，现有的NIAH基准测试各自存在以下一个或多个局限性：(1) 依赖合成数据，因此其评估结果可能无法推广到真实世界场景；(2) 复用之前已发布的数据集，导致基准测试污染的风险；(3) 依赖人工标注，这需要耗费人力来创建和更新数据，并且容易在未来发生基准测试污染；以及(4) 对长上下文多跳推理进行了不切实际的简化——即每一步在给定前面步骤的情况下都很简单，而真实世界的推理往往需要在多条可能的证明路径上进行规划。为了解决这些局限性，我们引入了\Benchmark，这是一个基于已发表科学论文之间真实引用关系构建的动态基准测试（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: GraphNIAH提出了一个基于真实科学论文引用关系构建的动态基准测试，用于评估长上下文图推理能力，克服了现有大海捞针基准依赖合成数据、数据污染风险和人工标注等局限性。
en_tdlr: GraphNIAH introduces a dynamic benchmark built from real citation relationships among scientific papers to evaluate long-context graph reasoning, overcoming limitations of existing NIAH benchmarks such as reliance on synthetic data, contamination risks, and manual annotation.
